judge.reason: The note calls Qxh2+ a 'fork' and claims it 'wins material decisively,' but tracing the full sequence (including the White king's final recapture of the rook) shows Black actually sacrifices a queen and rook for only a rook and two pawns—a net material loss, not a winning line, so the core accuracy, justification, and teaching point are all built on a false premise.
